prose:
MacRumors reports Apple account and cloud-service problems, first describing sign-in issues and later adding services listed on Apple’s status pages. Social reports mention a wider set of symptoms, but those reports are not equivalent to confirmed outages for every service.

This is a time-specific incident report. It does not establish a common cause, a cyberattack or that the disruption remains ongoing when read later.
highlights: Report separates status-page listings from social reports
Account sign-in was among reported symptoms
Listed services changed during the incident
Current status needs a fresh official check
